title: An Act Providing Appropriations and Allocations for State Government Operations

summary.text:
This bill is a concept draft pursuant to Joint Rule 208.

This bill proposes to provide appropriations and allocations necessary for the operation of State Government.

chamber_actions.action: Received by the Secretary of the Senate on February 20, 2025 and REFERRED to the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS AND FINANCIAL AFFAIRS pursuant to Joint Rule 308.2
CARRIED OVER, in the same posture, to the next special or regular session of the 132nd Legislature, pursuant to Joint Order SP 519.
CARRIED OVER, in the same posture, to any special or regular session of the 132nd Legislature, pursuant to Joint Order SP 800.
Died in Possession of the Committee Upon Conclusion of the 132nd Legislature and PLACED IN THE LEGISLATIVE FILES (DEAD).
